-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Browserbase API credentials and connectivity.

session-create.name: session-create
session-create.description: Create a new Browserbase cloud browser session. Returns a sessionId to use with all other tools, and opens a Live View window so you can watch the browser in real time.

params.proxies: Enable residential proxies for stealth (default: false)
params.proxyCountry: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for proxy geolocation (e.g. "ES" for Spain, "US" for USA). Only used when proxies is true.
params.proxyCity: City name for proxy geolocation (e.g. "Madrid", "New York"). Only used when proxies is true.
params.stealth: Enable stealth mode to bypass bot detection (default: false)
params.advancedStealth: Enable advanced stealth mode for stronger bot detection bypass (default: false)
params.blockAds: Block ads in the browser (default: false)
params.os: Operating system to simulate for stealth mode
params.region: Server region where the session runs (default: us-west-2)
params.keepAlive: Keep session alive after disconnections (requires Hobby plan or above)
params.contextId: Reuse a saved browser context ID (cookies, localStorage, etc.)
params.persistContext: Persist the context after the session ends (default: false). Only used when contextId is provided.

session-list.name: session-list
session-list.description: List all active Browserbase sessions in this instance.

session-close.name: session-close
session-close.description: Close a Browserbase session and release cloud resources.

navigate.name: navigate
navigate.description: Navigate the browser to a URL.

navigate-back.name: navigate-back
navigate-back.description: Go back to the previous page.

snapshot.name: snapshot
snapshot.description: Capture an accessibility snapshot of the current page. Returns the page structure with element refs for interaction.

get-content.name: get-content
get-content.description: Get the current page HTML or plain text content.

params.format: Return full HTML or plain text (default: text)

take-screenshot.name: take-screenshot
take-screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. Saved to /workspace/ on the shared volume.

network-requests.name: network-requests
network-requests.description: List network requests made in the current session.

params.includeStatic: Include static resources (images, fonts, scripts). Default: false

click.name: click
click.description: Click on an element in the page.

params.ref: Element ref from snapshot (e.g. s1e3) or CSS selector

type.name: type
type.description: Type text into an editable element.

params.ref: Element ref from snapshot or CSS selector
params.slowly: Type character by character (triggers key handlers)

fill-form.name: fill-form
fill-form.description: Fill multiple form fields at once.

evaluate.name: evaluate
evaluate.description: Execute JavaScript in the page context.

params.function: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when ref is provided
params.ref: Optional element ref to pass as argument

wait-for.name: wait-for
wait-for.description: Wait for text to appear/disappear on the page, or wait a fixed amount of time.

name: Browserbase
description: Cloud browser automation at scale. Anti-bot bypass, CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, session recording, and parallel browsers. Includes Live View to watch the browser in real time.

changelog.notes: Initial release — run cloud browsers with stealth and CAPTCHA solving, navigate pages, capture screenshots, click, type, and fill forms
